# google_parameter_manager_parameter

Get information about a Parameter Manager Parameter.



## Example Usage

```hcl
data "google_parameter_manager_parameter" "default" {
  parameter_id = google_parameter_manager_parameter.parameter-basic.parameter_id
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:



* `parameter_id` -
  (Required)
  This must be unique within the project.


* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
